output.explanation: The commission column was renamed from COMM_AMT to COMMISSION_AMOUNT, as the new header has no COMM_AMT and COMMISSION_AMOUNT holds the commission values (e.g. $250.17 on a $2,382.61 premium), so both columns.commission and totalRow.amountColumn now point to it; all other fields keep their current columns because their headers and sample values (e.g. BS-2195449-02, 09/01/2026) are unchanged.
